chapter.verse: Italy gam teembaw-ah tuangin ka pai ding uh a kitel khit ciangin, Julias min nei Augustus pawl galkap mangpa’ khut tungah Paul leh thong sunga kikhum midangte a pai uh hi.
Asia gam tuipi gei-ah a om khuate ah pai dinga kisa Adramittium teembaw tungah tuangin ka pai uh hi. Makedonia gam Thesalonika khua mi Aristarkhas kote tawh a omkhawm hi.
A zing ciangin Sidon khua ka tun’ uh ciangin, ama lawmte kiangah pai-in an vakna a ngah theih nadingin Julias in Paul hehpihin thu a pia hi.
Tua khua pan ka paikhia uh a, huih kituak lo ahih ciangin Saipras lam gam huih dalsakin pai-in,
Kilikia gam leh Pamfilia gam kikal tuipi ka galkah uh ciangin Licia gam Mura khua-ah ka tung uh hi.
Tua khua-ah Italy gamah a pai ding Alekzandria teembaw khat galkap mangpa in mu a, tua teembaw tungah kote hong tuang sak hi.

Damdamin pai-in, ni tampi ka pai khit uh ciangin Nidas khua tawh a kitang mun haksapi-in ka tun’ khit uh ciangin, huih kiphu zo nawn lo ahih ciangin Krete gam huih kidalsakin Salmone leizum tawh a kitang takin ka pai uh a,
Krete gam pamah pai-in Lasia khua tawh kinai Khawlmun Nuam kici mun khatah haksapi-in ka tung uh hi.
Ni tampi bei a, antan’na hun bei zo ahih ciangin, tuipi galkah nading launa om ahih manin Paul in,
“Tote aw, tuipi galkah leng teembaw leh vante tham loin, eite nuntakna zong kisia ding hi ci-in ka thei hi,” ci-in kikep nading thu a hilh hi.
Ahih hangin galkap mangpa in Paul’ kam ngai loin teembaw ukte leh teembaw neite thu a ngai hi.

Tua teembaw khawlna munah phalbi sung tawntung om huai lo ahih ciangin, “Tua lai mun pan paikhia-in Foenik khua i tun’ zawh leh, phaibi sung tawntung tua lai-ah tam leng a hoihzaw ding hi,” ci-in mi a tamzaw in a gen uh hi. Foenik khua in Krete gam teembaw khawlna mun hi a, saklam nitumna leh khanglam nitumna lam a maingat khawm hi.
Khang lam huih in damtakin hong nun’ ciangin kipai thei ding hi ci-in ngaihsunin khawlna sikkawi lian a khai khit uh ciangin a pai uh a, Krete tuipi gei kinai-ah a pai uh hi.
A sawt kihal loin Eurakuilo kici huihpi in lei lam panin nung a,
tembaw in phu zo lo ahih ciangin kote in nial zo loin huih mutna lam ka zui uh hi.
Kauda kici tuikulh huih kidalsakin ka pai uh a, gunkuang kisia lo dingin haksapi-in ka la uh a,

teembaw tungah a khai khit uh ciangin, khau tawh teembaw a gak uh hi. Sirti kici sehnel tungah ka awk khak ding uh hi cih ka lunghihmawh manunah puan a sutkhiat khit ciangin huih in hong mut a, hong lenpih hi.
Tui kihot pha mahmaha kiliing ahih ciangin zingsang ciangin vante tui sungah a paaikhia uh hi.
Ni thum khit ciangin amaute khut uh tawh teembaw nate a paaikhia uh hi.
Ni leh kha leh aksite sawt veipi kimu loin, huihpi nakpi nung ahih ciangin, ka suahtak ding uh lametna a om kei hi.

Amaute in an ne loin, sawt veipi a om khit uh ciangin Paul in amaute laizangah ding-in “Tote aw, ka thu na ngaih uh leh, Krete gam panin pai loin na om le-uhcin, hih kisiatna tawh na kipelh ding uh hi.
Tu-in ahih leh, lungmang kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, teembaw longal, kuamah a kisia kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hong uk leh kei in a na ka sepsak Pasian’ vantungmi khat in tuzanin ka kiangah ding a,
‘Paul aw, nang lunghimawh kei in. Kaisar kumpipa mai-ah na ding ding hi. Nangmah tawh teembaw sungah a omkhawm mi khempeuhte Pasian in nang hong pia zo hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tote aw, lungnuamin om un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kei tungah thu hong piak bang ahih ding Pasian suangin ka om hi.
Ahih hangin tuikulh khatpeuh tungah i kipaaikhia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ni sawm-le-li ni zaninah Andria tuipi sungah ka kikawi heihei lai takun, zan kim ciangin a kinaipen gam khat peuhmah ka tung dektak uh ci-in teembaw nasemte in ummawh uh a,
tui a teh ciangun lam sawmnih a thuk a thei uh hi. Tawmvei khit ciangin tui a tehkik uh ciangin, lam sawm-le-nga a thuk a thei uh hi.
Suangpi ka phut khak ding uh a lunghimawh manunah, teembaw tawlam a mong gei panin teembaw khawlna sikkawi li a khia uh a, khuavak ding ka ngak uh hi.
Teembaw nasemte in teembaw a taisan nuam uh a, teembaw lu lam panin teembaw khawlna sikkawi khiatsuk bangin, gunkuang a khiatsuk lai takun,
Paul in, “Hih mite in teembaw tungah a om kei uh leh, note na suakta kei ding uh hi,” ci-in galkap mangpa leh galkapte kiangah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin galkapte in gunkuang khau sat tat uh a, a khahkhia uh hi.
Khua a vak dektak lai takin an ne dingin Paul in mi khempeuh hansuah a, “Note in ni sawm-le-li tawntung an ngawlin, gil kialin na om uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin an ne dingin kong thuum hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note noptuam nading ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note samzang khat nangawn kisia lo ding hi,” ci-in a gen khit ciangin Paul in, khomun la a, tua mite mai-ah Pasian’ hehpihna a phat khit ciangin balnenin a ne hi.
Tua ciangin amaute khempeuh in zong lungnuamin an a ne uh hi.
Teembaw sungah a om komau khempeuh in zanih sawm-sagih-guk ka pha uh hi.
An a nek khit uh ciangin buhhumte tuipi sungah khia-in teembaw a zangsak uh hi.
Khua a vak ciangin tua gam a theih loh uh hangin, tui gei-ah sehnel a om, tui dawk khat a mu uh hi. Tua sehnel tungah teembaw kikhangsak ding hiam, kikhangsak lo ding hiam ci-in a vaihawm uh hi.
Sikkawi a khahkhia uh a, tuipi sungah a nutsiat khit uh ciangin, a hawhna a phel uh a, teembaw lu lam panin a puan huih lakah khai-in tui dawk lamah teembaw a phusak uh hi.
Tui kilokna nih kituahna mun a phak uh ciangin teembaw leitungah kingam a, teembaw a lulam teng tang thei loin om a, a nung lam tui kilok in satkhia a, a sia hi.
Tua lai takin thongkiate in tui peeka a taimang ding uh a lunghihmawh manunah galkapte in, “That ni,” ci-in a vaihawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin galkap mangpa in Paul a suahtaksak nop maninah galkapte’ hihna kham a, “Tui peek siamte in peek masa uh a, lei tungah a tung masa ding uh hi.
A om laite in singpeek tung ahi zongin, teembaw sungah a om nadangte tung ahi zongin, tuangin a pai ding uh hi.” ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuhte in lei tungah a suakta uh hi.
